subject: SKU hierarchy & value mapping — AWS Offer copy + field playbook
messages:
From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@aws-partner.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace readiness — SKU taxonomy + value bullets for Aperture Offer

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our checklist, AWS needs a clean SKU hierarchy and short value bullets for each SKU line so the listing and entitlement matrix align with co-sell materials. Aperture wants to publish 3 SKUs (Dev, Standard, Enterprise) with bundled inference credits.

I've attached a CSV with the suggested SKU codes and a doc with proposed 1-line and 2-line product snippets. Can your listing owner review and confirm which of the proposed snippets can be used verbatim, and flag any claims that need tone-down for marketplace compliance?

Key asks:
- Confirm SKU code structure (we need 8-char SKU IDs)
- Approve one-liners for hero + 3 SKU short bullets (<=120 chars)
- Call out any legal/compliance footnote language we should add to pricing (trial/usage disclaimers)

Cc'ing Aditya (pricing lead) and Kimberly (product copy). If possible, we'd like a final pass by Thurs 1/19 so Aperture can finish onboarding.

Best,
Maria
Partner Solutions Manager — AWS Marketplace

Attachments: SKU_mapping_v3.csv (CSV), proposed-copy-snippets.docx (DOCX)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@aws-partner.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace readiness — SKU taxonomy + value bullets for Aperture Offer

Maria — thanks, received. Quick read-through below and an initial plan.

1) SKU codes: the CSV looks fine, but we prefer a semantic prefix that encodes product family + tier (e.g., RDW-APTR-DEV). We'll map to the 8-char AWS IDs at upload time (we can do both but keep semantic in our matrix).

2) Copy: Kimberly, can you review the attached snippet doc for compliance tone? I'll call out where to prefer conservative phrasing.

3) Pricing footnotes: Aditya, please advise on the recommended billing footnote language for burst credits and the trial SKU. We need to ensure the 'trial' SKU doesn't cause accidental entitlement duplication with trial periods from other channels.

Action plan:
- Kimberly to return redline by Wed 1/17 EOD
- Aditya to propose footnote language Wed 1/17 midday
- I'll consolidate and send final to Maria by Thurs 1/19 AM

Jonas Weber
Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, maria.garcia@aws-partner.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jan 2028 08:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace readiness — SKU taxonomy + value bullets for Aperture Offer

Jonas / Maria — I reviewed the proposed-copy-snippets.docx and made inline notes. High level: the hero one-liner is fine but we should avoid comparative claims such as 'lowest-latency' without explicit benchmark data. I've replaced a couple of claims with feature-focused benefits (e.g., 'predictable per-token pricing' instead of 'lowest cost').

Suggested short bullets for each SKU (<=120 chars):
- Dev: 'Sandbox-ready instance for prototype workloads — includes 100k inference credits.'
- Standard: 'Production inference with autoscaling and prefix caching for reduced latency.'
- Enterprise: 'SLA-backed capacity, private VPC option, and audit logging.'

I've attached an exported doc with redlines. Also, add this footnote for trials: 'Trial credits expire 30 days after activation and are non-transferable.' That should satisfy marketplace compliance.

Attachment: proposed-copy-snippets_redline.docx (see notes)

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Copy — Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, maria.garcia@aws-partner.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jan 2028 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace readiness — SKU taxonomy + value bullets for Aperture Offer

Quick pricing footnote suggestion to include on the offer page and pricing table: 'Usage beyond included credits billed monthly at listed per-token rate; burst capacity subject to availability.' For the Enterprise SKU we should add: 'Contact sales for overage and reserved capacity terms.'

Also flagged: if Aperture wants to include quantized model variants as separate SKUs, we need to decide whether those are pricing tiers or add-on SKUs (recommended: add-on to keep entitlement matrix simpler).

Aditya Rao
Pricing & Packaging
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@aperture-analytics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Singhal <priya.singhal@aperture-analytics.com>, samir.patel@reseller-co.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace readiness — SKU taxonomy + value bullets for Aperture Offer

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. A few clarifications from my side after reviewing Kimberly's redlines:

- We will accept the toned-down claims; can you confirm the hero header can read 'High-performance inference with predictable economics'?
- For the Dev SKU, can the '100k' credits be represented as '100k inference credits (approx.)' — legal wants the approx notation.
- On add-on SKUs: we do plan to ship a quantized variant but prefer it as an add-on SKU to keep basic purchase flow simple.

Also linking to the co-sell playbook we assembled: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AperturePlaybookDraft

If you can push the final CSV and copy to us by EOD Thurs, we'll lock the marketplace onboarding slot for Jan 25.

—Alex
Head of Cloud Partnerships — Aperture Analytics
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@aws-partner.com>, alex.chen@aperture-analytics.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, samir.patel@reseller-co.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jan 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace readiness — SKU taxonomy & value mapping — Finalized pack

Maria / Alex — moving to final. Attached updated CSV and a cleaned copy doc per Kimberly's redlines and Aditya's footnotes. Summary of changes:

- SKU mapping: semantic prefix RDW-APTR- with final 8-char AWS SKU IDs in column B. Quantized model variants placed as 'ADD-QUANT' add-on SKUs.
- Hero header: 'High-performance inference with predictable economics' (approved by Aperture)
- Short bullets: use Kimberly's suggested phrasing; Dev has '100k inference credits (approx.)'
- Pricing footnotes: included 'Trial credits expire 30 days after activation and are non-transferable.' and 'Usage beyond included credits billed monthly at listed per-token rate; burst capacity subject to availability.'

Attachments: SKU_mapping_v3_final.csv, SKU_value_snippets_final.docx, co-sell-playbook.pdf

Next steps:
- Maria: please confirm upload window (we're ready for Jan 25 slot).
- Marissa: I'll hand this to you for field enablement content and one-pager creation.

Thanks everyone — nice cross-team sprint.

Jonas Weber
Partner GTM — Redwood Inference
